items.title: 24.6.1 Amino acids ki tezaabi aur basic khasiyatein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the acidic and basic properties of amino acids (PDF 130).

blocks.text: Amino acids amphoteric hain, lekin yeh zyada tar carboxylic acids se kam tezaabi aur zyada tar amines se kam basic hain. Amino acid molecule ka tezaabi hissa -NH3+ group hai, -COOH nahi, aur basic hissa -COO- group hai, -NH2 nahi. RNH3+ RCOOH se kamzor tezaab hai:

Aabi mehlool mein amino acid ke dipolar ion aur cationic aur anionic shakalon ke darmiyan equilibrium hota hai. Cationic shakal, H3N+-CH(R)-COOH, kam pH par ghalib hai; dipolar ion isoelectric pH par; aur anionic shakal, H2N-CH(R)-COO-, zyada pH par.

blocks.alt: H3N+-CH(R)-COOH (cationic shakal, kam pH par ghalib) equilibrium mein, teeron ke oopar OH- aur neeche H+, H3N+-CH(R)-COO- (dipolar ion, isoelectric pH par ghalib) ke saath, jo isi tarah H2N-CH(R)-COO- (anionic shakal, zyada pH par ghalib) ke saath equilibrium mein hai.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ki cationic shakal, dipolar ion aur anionic shakal (kitab ke PDF safha 130 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kam pH (zyada tezaab) par amino acid cation (H3N+ ... COOH) hai. OH- dalne se pehle -COOH ka proton jata hai aur dipolar ion banta hai; aur OH- dalne se -NH3+ ka proton bhi chala jata hai aur anion (H2N ... COO-) banta hai. H+ dalne se ulta hota hai. Kitab ne dipolar ion ke baad '+ OH-' bhi likha hai; OH- yahan banta nahi balke teer par diya gaya reagent hai, is liye drawing mein use chhor diya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Isoelectric point (pI)
blocks.text: Isoelectric point woh pH hai jis par zwitterion ka concentration sab se zyada aur amino acid par koi kul charge nahi hota. Har amino acid ka apna pI hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Bohat tezaabi mehlool mein amino acid kis shakal mein hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Cationic shakal, H3N+-CH(R)-COOH: carboxylate group ne proton le liya hai.

items: Tezaabi hissa -NH3+ (pKa taqreeban 10); basic hissa -COO- (pKb taqreeban 12).
Kam pH: cation; pI: zwitterion; zyada pH: anion.
